title: Tests do not isolate DB — app uses ./books.db, test setup clears ./test-books.db
evidence: src/index.test.ts:7 calls getDb('./test-books.db') and DROPs/CREATEs there, but src/index.ts:13 calls getDb() which src/database.ts:4 defaults to './books.db'; the app under test never touches the cleared DB, so tests run against a persistent, un-reset ./books.db
suggestion: Make the app read the DB path from an env var (e.g. process.env.DB_PATH) and point both index.ts and the test at the same fresh path, or inject the db into the app

title: ?author= filter (R3) is implemented but not exercised by any test
evidence: src/index.ts:47-50 implements the author filter, but src/index.test.ts has no GET /books?author= assertion
suggestion: Add a test that creates books by two authors and asserts GET /books?author=X returns only that author's books

title: Running the app/tests writes books.db into the workspace root
evidence: src/database.ts:4 default path './books.db' is relative to CWD; no .gitignore excludes it, so a stray books.db can be archived with the run
suggestion: Write DB files under a tmp/ dir or gitignore *.db

title: README documents run/test but omits API endpoint reference
evidence: README.md lists npm install/start/test only; no mention of the /books or /health routes
suggestion: Add a short endpoint table (method, path, description) — optional, R11 is satisfied
